name: Marian Hobbs
story: As Environment Minister, Marian Hobbs launched the published Land Environments of New Zealand resource on 23 April 2003. Her release describes LENZ as a nationally consistent environmental classification built from climate, soil and landform variables and produced by the Ministry for the Environment with Landcare Research.
